integrity: Equilibrium coordinates and Jacobian identities were reconstructed from the printed equations and checked by exact symbolic and rational arithmetic. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the printed deterministic replicator system; the eleven-point census is for the published baseline calibration. The general theorem covers fully mixed equilibria under positive coupling sums and does not classify every degenerate boundary case or global basin geometry.
title: Three omitted mixed equilibria in a triple-helix replicator model
